case_number: CIVIL APPEAL NO.  OF 2023 (ARISING OUT OF SLP (C) NO. 10519 OF 2020)

parties.respondent: The State Of Madhya Pradesh & Ors.

summary: Regularization claim of daily-rated supervisor; minimum qualification deficiency (matriculation with mathematics) relaxed by circular; no sanctioned post/vacancy; no competent authority appointment; reliance on junior daily wage regularizations; Umadevi precedent applied; HC Division Bench correctly overturned Single Judge's regularization order; appeal dismissed.
legal_provisions_cited: Secretary, State of Karnataka and Ors. v. Umadevi and Ors. (2006) 4 SCC 1
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court order allowing State's appeal confirmed.
